Small Savings Scheme Interest Rates Unchanged for July-September Quarter

The government has announced that interest rates for various small savings schemes, including PPF, SSY, Kisan Vikas Patra, NSC, and SCSS, will remain unchanged for the July to September 2026 quarter. This decision continues a trend of stable rates that have been in place for an extended period across these popular savings instruments.
